run_recipe: run a fairseq2 recipe with a config and output directory for training or inference
train_recipe_deprecated: run a deprecated train recipe that delegates to the run function
evaluate_recipe_deprecated: run a deprecated evaluate recipe that delegates to the run function
generate_recipe_deprecated: run a deprecated generate recipe that delegates to the run function
dump_recipe_config: dump a fairseq2 recipe config to a YAML file in the output directory
